name: Kanban board adapt mobile
description:
1. The task: the `tasks` view (`KanbanBoardView.vue`) has a left board-selector column that must be collapsed on mobile.
2. I inspected `KanbanBoardView.vue`, its `KanbanBoardSidebar`, canvas, sprint view, and confirmed the mobile flag source (`this.$ui.isMobile`).
3. Fix: initialize `sidebarCompact` from `isMobile`, add an `isMobile` watcher to sync on breakpoint changes.
4. On mobile the expanded sidebar now renders as an overlay drawer (`absolute inset-y-0 left-0 z-40`) with a tappable scrim instead of pushing the canvas.
5. Changes were limited to one file, `src/components/kanban/board/KanbanBoardView.vue`, with template, computed, watch, and scoped-style updates.

history.summary:
1. The task: the `tasks` view (`KanbanBoardView.vue`) has a left board-selector column that must be collapsed on mobile.
2. I inspected `KanbanBoardView.vue`, its `KanbanBoardSidebar`, canvas, sprint view, and confirmed the mobile flag source (`this.$ui.isMobile`).
3. Fix: initialize `sidebarCompact` from `isMobile`, add an `isMobile` watcher to sync on breakpoint changes.
4. On mobile the expanded sidebar now renders as an overlay drawer (`absolute inset-y-0 left-0 z-40`) with a tappable scrim instead of pushing the canvas.
5. Changes were limited to one file, `src/components/kanban/board/KanbanBoardView.vue`, with template, computed, watch, and scoped-style updates.
